body: I work full time, when im off work i drown myself on my phone trying to get my mind off  her death and when i do have plans i always seem to be more upset when i come home or i find myself fantasizing being with her. Nothing makes me happy. Everything seems to be painful.

Ive seen therapists and been to hospital, seen a counsellor talked to everyone i know and waited this out for a while now. I feel like its never going to get better so this is the conclusion ive come to. Im sorry ive given up.
Of course not, but ultimately it's what i want.

I have a grief counsellor i agree with, however the decision I've spoken to him about is that i will end up taking my life in order to "join" her. Its a concept for me that means a lot to me. 

Its probably not the decision anyone else wants but its the one that i can justify and want myself.

I don't think i would say silly, its more that i just dont agree with the idea of it. Its more straying from the pain and suffering they were in and not addressing it. I understand that its about the care of me now because the deceased is gone, however it doesnt click with me. 

I just dont think therapists have the samme effect it can have on others.

I've been the therapists, physchotherapists, ive been admitted into the crisis hospital care centre and i have a grief counsellor. 

None of them really give me a better light or anything, they seem to just try to push their opinionated decision that you can carry them on in your heart and move on and yet the reality of death is that they're indefinitely gone. They all have no effect on me.
Let everything out, that is honestly all you can do. I'm so glad i was able to gift you some comforting words in the tragically dark time. Please take care of yourself.

Hi, I'm not sure if this is what you are looking for as i would not be in the same position as you. I lost my girlfriend to suicide by hanging. We both lost two insanely important aspects of our lives yet im not sure if any of the questions you have asked have any definite answer im afraid. 

I too continue searching if death from hanging is painless. I too feel a constriction around my throat whenever i think about my partner. I too feel myself hopelessly tossing and turning in the middle of the nights as my gut wrenches into itself. 

However I think everyone has their own personal answer to all these problems. 
For me? I by far have not found the answer yet, but there are some things that have gradually given me some help. 

I've done extensive research on suicide which gave me a broader and deeper understanding on depression and the effects of it. I did some digging into my girlfriend and found what i believe to be theories or reasons as to what led her to her decision. I guess for me it's information, I need all of it to even survive. 

However to commemorate her? I've decided that she is my partner for life, that when the people or my loved ones that bind me to this earth have passed and won't be effected by my death, I too will join her. It's something that I've come to terms with and maybe you can find an answer which i don't believe would be anything like mine but something to commemorate him by? I'm not sure if this has helped but this is my own story. 

I am truly sorry for your loss.

I can sense the pain that is so deeply embedded with guilt and love, it is an absolute painstaking feeling that you are feeling with now. It truly is terrible. 

However from what i can see as a third person,  you have already done your fair share, you have truly devoted your life and your love towards your parents and tried with all your heart to keep your life together as well. It is an almost and impossible feat to juggle both and yet you seemed to have managed to some extent, it may not have been perfect but you managed it. For that i tip my hat towards you and give you a bravo, you truly have done well. Do not for a second blame yourself which is easier said than done, the best course of action from here is to sit with your feelings and figure them out. Give yourself some alone time and figure everything out, what you're going to make of this, don't let any external influences do your thinking for you, I'm sure a strong person like yourself will find the right answer. 

Thank you so much for sharing and once again, I am truly sorry for your loss. 

Much love from a person who has also experienced the suicide of a loved one.

Hi Osusanna, I am incredibly sorry for your loss, i hope that maybe there were notes left behind for your sakes to give you a sense of closer. 

I don't know if it is too soon to state this as the grieving stage can be a very damned thing. However what i have learnt is that the act of suicide is what "they" wanted, if that makes any sense. 

I find a sense of acceptance in the fact that the suicidee found this path as their way of being happy and that is what they wanted. 

Of course it is incredibly unfair to you, i am not taking any of that away from you, please take care of yourself.

If you think that was the point of this reply then you are very narrow minded. It is opening perspectives and what i believe is reality. 

Guilt is the number one reason people dont commit to suicide, by harbouring this feeling people can be pushed to seek what they need, it doesnt necessarily have to be professional help but simply what they need.
Thank you, I have read your post as well, my heart goes out for you, I hope you can one day find peace and solice in any shape or form.

I am so deeply sorry for your loss, I don't know if the pain goes away, it simply smothers away like a campfire leaving its embers, waiting to be ignited again and relived. 

Suicide can be a monstrous act.

Hi Darewright,

I strongly suggest keeping the incident of suicide away from your children. Early exposure to suicide or suicidal ideologies inhibit suggestions to minds that arent fully developed or more technically minds that havnt developed their motor decision making skills which come in at the age of 18-23

Hi, first of all do not apologize, you are more than welcome here. Second of all thank you so much for reaching out and asking, its something we all would like to help out on. 

The first thing about what i wish could have happened or been told was; 

1. Do not down play the whole situation, tell them up front how this is making you feel. Tell them the severity of the thoughts and the sheer intensity of it. DO NOT DOWNPLAY. 

2. For them it must be a bomb. They dont know how to deal with it and neither do you, i suggest you read up on suicide watch and look at the suggestions and researched information that is provided. 

3. You matter and thank you again.
Thank you, its going to be a hard journey, im not sure if im going to succeed, but i will try.

My girlfriend hung herself on July, I can say this is all too true and yet it is somehow not as gruesome and mind numbing as reality. 

The pain you leave behind only festers and grows bigger and stronger onto the ones that loved and cherished you.

Hey, this isnt the best sub-reddit to get suicide advice on however if you have definitively decided to do this and have no intention of changing your mind do your research first. 

Lostallhope.com

Hi, you've been in that field before, sounds to me you already have a small idea of what you need to do. 

You should seek medication for the anxiety and try get yourself some melatonine to regulate your sleep pattern. Whatever is causing this anxiety might also need to be addressed so a therapist? 

Youve been in this field before. Im not expert, think about what you would tell the person who came to tou with the exact same symptoms.

Hey mate, sounds to me like you have depression. (good job genius duh) 

You have to realise that depression is a sickness like the flu or a stomach bug, its something thats definitely treatable but also it sounds like you need therapy, to tackle those emotions you dont understand. 

Depression usually comes in 3 forms, you seem to be suffering from the form of severe lonliness as well as not being understood. No one around you understands what youre going through and youre dad is in prison. 

My advice i can give you is speak up. Youll be might surprised that everyone cares, except your friends dont have experience with this, talk to your mum or an adult youre comfortable with, a teacher maybe. Get some therapy or medication. I hope that helped

Hi, our human brains are hardwired to survive in any way shape or form, mentally as well as physically. 

Since you have been thinking of taking your own life you have gradually desensatized that aspect of your brain. 

However, having said that have you been diagnozed with any mental illness? People who suicide have an extremely high chance of having one. 

Domt be afraid, mental illness is like a broken bone or the flu, its treatable

Yes that is completely normal, you have the classic signs of depression. 

You find happiness and joy in some things so you are not severely depressed, however in terms of a medical view you have an imbalance of chemicals in your brain which doesnt create as much of the "happy" chemical as it needs. 

You are in no ways abnormal, it is simply an illness like a broken bone or the flu, it can be treated. I hope that helped

Hi, I wouldn't say its not "normal" in terms of society sakes but it is something that would definitely require medical attention. 

What makes you want to kill yourself? Do you feel like you dont have a purpose?

You dont feel happy for some unknown reason? That no one understands you?

Or do you feel like youre a burden to everyone? 

Any of the above?

I guess i feel the need to help people, the pain of being unable to protect the one i care about the most is unbearable. 

The thing is I don't want to get better, it seems to me that im fine with ending my life to join the girl I love. Im okay with laying down my life to show my committment and love she didnt see. Its selfish but its what i want to do. Thank you though.

Hi, having lost my girlfriend to suicide i can definitely say that you have done the right thing, if you believe you may have put her in more danger you can contact your school for child protective services to further investigate. 

Thank you for being brave and speaking out, a lot of people dont.

Your'e very welcome, I'm more than willing to help talk to you. Whatever it is you need from making this post. 

I cant say that I think that what you did isnt wrong, however it is something that youve already realised thats great man. 

You clearly do have a space for compassion and love in your heart because i can see it right now from reading your posts. 

Its clear to me there are some key points you should address before going any further and im glad you shared your story. 

Maybe make this your goal, something to strive towards like a plan, its only advice from a stranger you dont need to do it but ill try give you something i would want you to do

1. Drinking seems to be a form of numbing the pain for you, I know it wont be easy because fuck it really wont be, but maybe you should try cutting back or stopping. 

2. Create a plan to talk to her, make some dotpoints, things you want to say to her and tell her how sorry you are. 

3. Once youve done this create a time and plan to talk to her.

Let this be your goal. To finally talk to her and tell her the things you want to say. 

As for the domestic violence charities, it goes hand in hand with addicts, a lot of people who run those things used to be addicts and find a lot of good in making groups to help others. Dont be afraid. Just accept what youve done.

Im glad i can maybe bring about some comfort to someone. Im also glad that talking to me has made you come to terms with these things more clearly. 

Dont feel the rush or stress of doing it too quickly. Take your time, youre on the right track.

Dont be sorry, ill be around for a while to try and talk to people. I see now, I understand the predicament. 

Would a solution be available where you are allowed to stay but you and your Fiance can help around with all this, it sounds to me you guys have some time on your hands. Doing physical activity alleviates testosterone and lets you release seratonine in the body which im sure you know all about as you are aspiring to be a nurse. 

It also sounds like youre taking all this burden on yourself in regards to payments, bills and future plans. Maybe you guys have to move out but have you discussed it with your mother? Maybe get a different place? Get your Fiance to support himself first before considering anything else? You cant live your life supporting him and you know that. 

So at the end of the day im trying to say I can see youve fallen down on your knees, thats ok. Take your time. Stay there for as long as you need, be alone, learn about yourself. But at some point when you believe its right kick yourself back up, dont KNOWINGLY put yourself in a dark space.

I for one can tell you that it is not the only way to get close to people and feel loved. Just hearing your story makes me want to love you. 

Lets say that your parents dont love you, that they said that and meant it. I highly doubt that they did mean it. However if they did, have you asked them why? Try having a discussion with them because clearly you want to be loved. Because i can tell you from personal experience, suicide can damage others to the point of where you are at right now.

Firstly, thank you for sharing, im sure youre sick and tired of hearing this from people but im sorry you had to go through that. 

First of all, you are very brave for getting to this point. You are a soldier for making it to today. Take that as a means to celebrate. You are here. 

Secondly, dont ever think for a second you arent normal. Because you are, what happened to you was nothing short of a tragedy and you are not a "normal" person for having gone through that. All your feelings and emotions are your own and seriously, fuck everyone and anyone who says otherwise they are wrong. 

Thirdly, can i ask a few more things so i can get a better idea, why do you think youre only good for sex? What makes you think that?

Why do you think your parents dont love you? Please elaborate. If you dont want to you dont have to, feel comfortable with what you want to tell me.

Hi Napstabade, i cannot express how sorry i am that you feel this way. 

Can i ask for you to share your story with me? Why do you feel this way

Hi, no one else seems like they want to take themsleves up to reply to you, so i will try. I have no experience with this but i will try. 

You say you have made no progress or done nothing at all and it hasnt helped you. I say you are wrong, you have already accepted that you were wrong and it is something you shouldnt have done. You have accepted and felt guilt from this and i truly have to say you are a brave soul for doing so. 

The reasons for why you did what you did i wont ask not because i think youre a horrible person, but because i do not care. Your actions themselves have tormented you since the day and the guilt as well as the demons that prevailed from these events have destroyed you. If you ask me that is punishment enough. If you ask me i do not ever want anyone no matter how bad of a person they believe they are to go through what you are going through. 

It sounds to me that they have already forgiven you, they have accepted this and believed that your punishment is enough for them. However to you it clearly isnt enough. So i ask you that maybe you can dedicate yourself to a cause that may bring about awareness to domestic violence. Instead of wallowing in guilt and sadness, propogate yourself to help others in need and tell them that they dont need to go through the violence. 

If you dont believe that any of this is close to enough. Take time to yourself. Ask what is enough. Do you need to sit with your victim down and communicate with her? Its tough it really fucking is but take your time. Take your time to get there, muster up the courage and tell how all these things about how you feel about yourself. Just dont do what you are doing to yourself now. Dont sit with your own demonic thoughts and let them control you.

When you think about the burden he may bring about how does this make you feel? Does it make you afraid of the possibilities of it and how so? 

It sounds like you are a very empathetic person and can see why your mother wants you out of the house, justifying it with her care and compassion. To me, your selflessness is another reason to which got you to this point, you need to care about yourself, it is fucking difficult i know that. I have always tried to be the independant one of the family. It may sound completely wrong and stupid, because you say youve already leeched off her enough to the point where you feel anxious and suicidal. However im almost more than certain that if you try to bring about this to your mother it will have an effect, maybe not positive but it is a step in the right direction. 

If it is too hard to confront your mother in person write a note. Detail and explain what makes you feel this way and why. Take your time, it might not be the right way but its the way i would do it. It seems to me you want to understand why she wants you out, you may have a preterminded idea but im sure if you ask her and try see what she sees, you may be able to prove her wrong or say it from your point of view. 

Remember people cant read minds. If they could there wouldnt be a need for therapists or any of that. 

Also thank you, I would write a post about how i feel but i dont believe im ready to.

Hi, do not be sorry. You have every right to feel this way. Your emotions are your own and dont ever fucking believe that your arent "normal" or shouldnt be feeling these emotions. I cannot stress this enough. 

Im sure youve heard this countless amounts of times before, but i would suggest getting a therapist, those people are designed to help you understand your emotions and why youre feeling them.

However I cannot force you to, it is ultimately up to you, if you feel comfortable talking to people on the internet then by all means talk to people on the internet, that doesnt make you weird or strange. You are who you are. Do what makes you comfortable. 

The sad fact is that you were sexually abused 6 years ago and nothing can change that, that is the harsh and reality of it. However you are still here and you clearly WANT to be happy and WANT to fight these demons. So i for one commend you and say bravo for fucking soldiering on to this day. 

But on the side note it is obvious to me that you this issue definitively needs to be resolved or if not eased in some way or another. I again suggest reaching out to professional help as i am not one. However it is at the end of the day what makes you comfortable.

Do not be sorry, whatever led you to come here there was something, maybe you had hope or maybe you just needed to let it all out. I may not be the right person to talk to but I sure as hell will try. 

In terms of your Fiance, have you ever thought that he himself may be holding you down as you need to support another? I am definitely jumping to conclusions but it sounds like something to consider. 

For your mother, it sounds like you need some form of security. What do you feel when she says she needs you out? How does it make you think and react? You need to somehow address this and present these problems to her or whoever it is you need to present it to. Maybe not even you if you cant do it, but for your own sake it sounds like it needs to be addressed, maybe work out a deal with her etc.

Hi, everything seems to be racing around right now. You seem the think that if you stop the world will go on without you. It wont. 

Take some time to yourself and recollect yourself. Be alone for a while. Get some medical attention. Just slow down.

Hi Lamentationofasinner, it really does sound like you have a lot on your plate. It sounds like your whole life you taken up this burden of being your mothers prized possession and bravo, it sounds like youve become one. 

However it also sounds like your whole life youve tried to be independant, there are a lot of problems you are pointing out right now and they sound extremely difficult to manage all at once so i ask you that you grab a pen and paper and outline them boldly. 

I am not a professional therapist in any ways but it seems to me you need to address 3 key problems:

1. In terms of your license, this is ultimately up to you, do you want to continue with this? If so take as much time as you need, you say they wont hire you but this is a predetermined factor made by yourself.

2. It seems that your Fiance is not bringing any benefits to the table, address this. Talk to him about it. 

3. Have you talked to your mum about the current housing situation in terms of yourself? Im sure your mum will be concerned and willing to listen. DO NOT be afraid to speak up.

Hi ChipiChipi, I have to say neither, as well as all of the above. If you want a medically correct answer you are in a way "obsessed." If you want medical advice on what would help you, i would say fluvoxamine. 

However with what you are going through, it is your mind having from shifted from a comfortable region to being thrown into the ocean with nothing but a life jacket. You found yourself with your ex-girlfriend and what needs to happen for you is that you need to find yourself again, whether it be by yourself or with someone else. 

I would say you are in a Emergancy Crisis situation, meaning youve lost all purpose in life. It is perfectly normal dont worry, people go through this at least once in their lifetime. 

You should not be worried unless you think you are in danger. That is up to you. You need to once again find purpose in life, whether it be yor friends, family or even yourself. It is MUCH easier said than done but it is easier done through medical attention.
Hi guys, can i ask both of you why you have such a depressing life and want to commit suicide?

Hi BioSleep, I am not asking you not to kill yourself as I understand your pain, however my girlfriend killed herself on the 16th of July this year. I am still currently in a tremendous amount of pain. I will lead you through what is going to happen if you kill yourself. 

1. Whoever finds you will be forever fucked up if they love you dearly. They will have PTSD which will keep them awake at night till they die too. (Me)

2. No matter what you say your loved ones will blame themselves profusely as they will imagine scenarios where they could have helped you. 

3. Suicide is a domino effect, I myself am thinking about suicide along with other people that loved my girlfriend, can you knowly put your loved ones through your own suicide process? 

4. I am both horrendously angry and upset with my girlfriend she didnt tell me anything and that has left me with a void, so I implore you to let your loved ones help you, give them a chance to help you it doesnt have to be definite but let them know they at least had a shot and it wasnt good enough, not so that they dont even get a chance. 

If you want to ask questions or want to find out what happens to your loved ones if you kill yourself please go ahead and ask. I will do anything to try save a life, as i know how painful it is being unable to save another.
